verdicts.claimQuote: publishes a StockReserved event to the message broker
verdicts.note: Intra-sentence gate: without it the event would seem to be published even when reserve or pricing fails.

verdicts.conditionQuote: If the ledger cannot reserve the full quantity, the orchestrator rejects the whole order; it never makes a partial reservation.
verdicts.claimQuote: It asks the stock ledger to reserve the requested quantity
verdicts.note: All-or-nothing failure behaviour; u13 already says publishing waits for success, so u13 stays true without it.

verdicts.conditionQuote: A reservation that is not confirmed within 15 minutes is released by the ledger
verdicts.claimQuote: It asks the stock ledger to reserve the requested quantity
verdicts.note: Expiry bound on a reservation; the reserve claim stays true but readers must know holds are temporary.

verdicts.conditionQuote: where they are cached for 300 seconds
verdicts.claimQuote: work out the price of an order from the supplier price lists and any active discounts
verdicts.note: Staleness bound: prices can lag supplier lists by up to 300 s.

verdicts.conditionQuote: Every 10 minutes it calls the supplier API for new deliveries
verdicts.note: Polling interval limits how fast restocks appear.

verdicts.conditionQuote: A delivery the adapter cannot parse is logged and skipped; it is not retried
verdicts.claimQuote: converts each delivery into a restock and asks the stock ledger to record it
verdicts.note: 'each delivery' is false for unparseable ones; also an exception to the retry wrapping in u34.

verdicts.claimQuote: the feed adapter wraps them in the retry helper
verdicts.note: Bounds of the retry policy and DLQ fallback; the wrapping claim stays true without them but they must be kept.

verdicts.conditionQuote: Retries apply only to supplier calls. Reservations are never retried automatically
verdicts.claimQuote: the feed adapter wraps them in the retry helper
verdicts.note: Scope of the retry helper; no stated claim becomes false without it.

verdicts.conditionQuote: whether that holds under peak load has not been measured
verdicts.claimQuote: At peak it handles about 3,000 reservations per hour.
verdicts.note: Reading 1: it undermines the peak-load and stock-consistency claims (u3, u27 source of truth), so claim; reading 2: an open known-gap caveat with no single claim made false, so set.

verdicts.conditionQuote: Dead-lettered deliveries are only found when someone opens the admin UI; nothing alerts the team
verdicts.claimQuote: staff review it in the admin UI
verdicts.note: Gap in how DLQ items are noticed; the review claim stays literally true.

additional.conditionQuote: The admin UI has no automated tests yet.
additional.claimQuote: Each module keeps its tests next to its code.
additional.note: If the admin UI counts as a module, u43 is false for it (claim); if 'module' means only the src/ modules, it is a separate gap (set).
